name: qsmxt-bids
label: QSMxT
description: Runs Neurodesk QSMxT 9.x on an XNAT MR session. The session's DICOM scans are mounted directly and QSMxT converts them to BIDS internally (qsmxt dicom-convert) before running the QSM pipeline, so no pre-existing NIFTI or BIDS scan resources are required.

inputs.name: premade
inputs.label: Pipeline preset
inputs.description: OpenRecon presets override the custom algorithm controls. Legacy presets remain available for existing configurations.

inputs.name: qsm-algorithm
inputs.label: QSM algorithm
inputs.description: QSMxT inversion algorithm for the Custom pipeline preset. HD-QSM is the OpenRecon default for a fast reconstruction with good QSM-CI performance.

inputs.name: unwrapping-algorithm
inputs.label: Unwrap
inputs.description: QSMxT phase unwrapping algorithm. ROMEO is the recommended default for multi-echo QSM.

inputs.name: bf-algorithm
inputs.label: Background removal
inputs.description: QSMxT background-field removal algorithm for the Custom pipeline preset. iSMV is the OpenRecon default, paired with ROMEO and HD-QSM.

inputs.name: masking-input
inputs.label: Threshold input
inputs.description: Input for the BET and Robust threshold mask presets. Magnitude is safer for single-echo acquisitions; phase quality is most useful with multiple echoes. Ignored by Combined and HD-BET.

inputs.name: mask-preset
inputs.label: Mask preset
inputs.description: Brain mask for Custom and OpenRecon presets. Combined (bet-and-phase) intersects BET on the magnitude with a thresholded phase-quality map, as recommended by the ISMRM consensus; HD-BET is a deep-learning brain extraction. Legacy presets retain their original masks.

inputs.name: do-swi
inputs.label: Generate SWI
inputs.description: Compute susceptibility-weighted images from magnitude and phase.

inputs.name: do-t2starmap
inputs.label: Generate T2* map
inputs.description: Quantitative relaxation time in seconds, distinct from T2starw magnitude. Requires at least three equally spaced magnitude echoes.

inputs.name: do-r2starmap
inputs.label: Generate R2* map
inputs.description: Quantitative relaxation rate in 1/s. Requires at least three equally spaced magnitude echoes. QSMxT computes T2* and R2* together when either is enabled.

inputs.name: do-smwi
inputs.label: Generate SMWI
inputs.description: Susceptibility map-weighted imaging: weights the magnitude by a mask built from the susceptibility map, so contrast stays at the source. Writes paramagnetic and diamagnetic SMWI images, each with its own minIP.

inputs.name: do-r2primemap
inputs.label: Generate R2' map
inputs.description: R2' (= R2* - R2) in 1/s. Requires R2* fitting. See R2' source for whether it is measured or predicted.

inputs.name: r2prime-strategy
inputs.label: R2' source
inputs.description: auto measures R2' from a multi-echo spin-echo scan when the session has one and otherwise predicts it with R2PRIMEnet; mese only measures (no output without MESE); r2primenet always predicts. A prediction is an estimate, not a measurement.

inputs.name: two-pass
inputs.label: Two-pass artefact reduction
inputs.description: Reconstruct a second time on a mask that keeps holes at strong susceptibility sources (air-tissue interfaces, haemorrhage, implants) to keep their streaking out of the rest of the brain. Roughly doubles background removal and inversion time and can be worse where the holes were not artefactual. The single-pass map is kept as desc-singlepass_Chimap.

inputs.name: do-segmentation
inputs.label: Segment brain (SynthSeg)
inputs.description: Whole-brain FreeSurfer-labelled segmentation from the GRE magnitude with SynthSeg (dseg.nii plus label table). Needs no T1w and no registration.

inputs.name: do-analysis
inputs.label: Per-structure susceptibility statistics
inputs.description: Median, mean, SD and 5th/95th percentile susceptibility per segmented structure (qsmstats.tsv). Implies segmentation.

outputs.name: qsmxt-output
outputs.description: QSMxT derivatives copied from the BIDS derivatives directory (derivatives/qsmxt/).

xnat.name: qsmxt-session
xnat.label: QSMxT
xnat.description: Run QSMxT on this MR session

external-inputs.name: session
external-inputs.description: Input MR session. Its DICOM scans are converted to BIDS inside the QSMxT container, so no pre-existing NIFTI/BIDS scan resources are needed. The session should contain multi-echo GRE (part-mag/part-phase) QSM series.
